newsitem.title: INDIA: India, China fail to sign investment guarantee.
newsitem.headline: India, China fail to sign investment guarantee.

text.p: India and China failed on Friday to sign a planned investment guarantee agreement because of differences between the two sides, a Chinese foreign ministry spokesman Shen Guofang said.
"The investment guarantee agreement was not signed because of some technical problem. There were some differences between the two sides," he told a news briefing in New Delhi.
The Press Trust of India (PTI) said the foreign ministers of the two countries initialled an agreement to minimise the possibility of armed conflict on their frontier.
They also initialled three other agreements -- on preventing illegal drug trafficking, direct shipping links and an Indian consulate office in Hong Kong after mid-1997, the agency said.
